dict.string: Untether needs to control terminal applications to create new terminal sessions from the dashboard.
Untether will notify you about important events such as new terminal connections, and session status changes.
Untether lets you browse, search and open files in your Desktop folder from the web dashboard and your phone.
Untether lets you browse, search and open files in your Documents folder from the web dashboard and your phone.
Untether lets you browse, search and open files in your Downloads folder from the web dashboard and your phone.
Untether lets you browse and open files on external drives from the web dashboard and your phone.
Untether lets you browse and open files on network drives from the web dashboard and your phone.
